brief_narrative:
Lusitania Telecom, a Portuguese mobile operator, sees three workstreams: customer analytics, retention offers and store operations. We would do the assessment and then support the rollout of the new retention program, three months in total.

The client asks why prepaid churn rose in 2025 and how to bring it down.

Stakeholders are the CEO and the Chief Commercial Officer.
